note: Searched all of agent/ for replay, checkpoint, retry, resume, recover, idempotency, backoff, requeue, restart, and for any read of the audit table or a startup scan of unfinished runs. Runs start only from POST /runs (main.py:159) as an in-memory asyncio task, and the loop (loop.py:125-186) keeps messages in memory with no persisted checkpoint. The audit table is write-only: audit.record is called but nothing selects from it to drive recovery. The only background job is expire_approvals_forever (main.py:68), which marks pending approvals expired and does not replay anything. Approvals are consulted by find_valid only when the model makes a fresh tool call in a new run. A pending approval returns 'do not retry until approved' (loop.py:75) and there is no automatic re-execution. The pay_invoice tool sends an Idempotency-Key (payments.py:33), but it is a single call with no retry loop. Nothing is resumed after a crash, so no logs or checkpoints drive recovery and no automatic replay exists. The N/A condition holds.
